paper.title: Uni-Skill: Building Self-Evolving Skill Repository for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
paper.central_claim: Uni-Skill 在规划时检测技能缺口、请求新技能实现，并借由从大规模无标注机器人视频构建的层级技能仓库 SkillFolder 进行检索条件化的少样本技能实现，实现超出预定义技能的零样本泛化。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: pinned text read before opening seat records (abstract, method, experiments, all tables, appendices; long proof derivations skimmed) ; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: To adapt the VLM to robotic manipulation tasks in a code-based framework, we trained it with 106K runtime code samples derived from videos demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: Upstream planner is trained; evaluation is of reusable non-weight skill repository/retrieval component, so A3 permits scope B, not a wholly training-free system.

evidence.quote: we extract over 10,000 skill-centric video segments from 350 hours demonstrations of DROID
evidence.support_explanation: Persistent raw demonstration substrate, automatically annotated rather than generated successful robot practice.

evidence.quote: When no suitable match is identified, a tree expansion mechanism is invoked to create a new child node, dynamically extending the hierarchy.
evidence.support_explanation: Four-level VerbNet/verb/object-description/slice hierarchy with local insertion; does not show execution-feedback admission.

evidence.quote: Furthermore, we discard candidates whose trajectories exhibit out-of-view movement or extended periods of inactivity.
evidence.support_explanation: CLIP scene matching plus simple trajectory filtering; quality gate is not downstream utility gate.

evidence.quote:

and

evidence.support_explanation: Retrieved examples condition waypoint and contact generation; depth lifting and orientation transfer yield executable poses.

evidence.quote: each task is evaluated over 25 episodes with binary success/failure scores, and the process is repeated three times to report mean and standard deviation of success rates.
evidence.support_explanation: Simulation binary success with 75 episodes/task across repetitions; standard deviations but no significance or intervals.

evidence.quote: Each task is evaluated over 10 trials, with the success rate serving as the evaluation metric. To ensure robustness, object instances and layouts are reconfigured after each trial.
evidence.support_explanation: Real robot evaluation, modest repeated sample size and varied layouts.

evidence.quote: when the skill updating mechanism is disabled, the system fails to perform reasonably on most of tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: Update-off plus semantic/spatial ablations support component relevance qualitatively; numerical figure unavailable in text, no fabricated values.

evidence.quote: Compared with robotic data, human-centric videos cover a broader and more diverse range of skill categories. However, human-centric videos primarily suffer from the absence of action annotations and contain blurred frames, which degrades the quality of generated skill repositories.
evidence.support_explanation: Source-domain robustness test; Table IV 0.41±0.01 DROID vs 0.29±0.02 sth2sth.

evidence.quote: Failure cases are incorporated as negative in-context examples, enabling the model to diagnose the error cause and re-plan the trajectory.
evidence.support_explanation: Within-execution feedback adaptation; persistence of negatives across independent tasks is not established.

evidence.quote: Out of 135 skill slices sampled from SkillFolder, only 2 showed semantic mismatches, 7 had occlusions or were too short, and zero execution failures.
evidence.support_explanation: Small annotation audit grounds filtering claims, not an independent retained-improvement experiment.

evidence.quote: To ensure fair comparison, all methods (CaP, MOKA, and Uni-Skill) share the same basic skill set
evidence.support_explanation: Shared primitive APIs but planner training and retrieval information not matched.

evidence.quote: Uni-Skill requests for new skill implementations when existing ones are insufficient, ensuring adaptable planning with self-augmented skill library.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心主张：规划时发现技能不足→请求新技能实现→自增强技能库。

evidence.quote: Each task is evaluated over 10 trials, with the success rate serving as the evaluation metric.

表 III 末行 CaP 平均印为 0.00，但同表 CaP 各任务 (0.8,0.2,0.8,0,0.5,0,0,0) 的均值为 0.29；MOKA 0.39、Uni-Skill 0.73 复核一致。我方复算。

evidence.quote: Comparison on different raw data sources.

evidence.quote: Out of 135 skill slices sampled from SkillFolder, only 2 showed semantic mismatches, 7 had occlusions or were too short, and zero execution failures.
evidence.support_explanation: 标注质量抽检 n=135，经过滤'低质量<2%'；抽样与判定方式未详述。

evidence.quote: we introduce a self-correcting mechanism that enforces a closed-loop process.
evidence.support_explanation: 唯一的闭环反馈：失败案例作为负例 in-context 重规划；是否跨回合保留、是否进入技能库未说明，仅一句'提升12%'。

evidence.quote: The failure modes fall into four types: planning errors, grounding errors, directional errors, and execution errors.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败边界：规划/落地/方向/执行四类（Fig 6），无分母。

evidence.quote: Exploring an alternative skill retrieval mechanism that jointly accounts for mechanical properties and semantic categories remains a meaningful direction
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认语义层级检索的限制（技能重叠）。
CaP's printed average is 0.00, but its per-task column (0.80, 0.20, 0.80, 0.00, 0.50, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00) averages 0.29. This is an internal table inconsistency.

evidence.quote: On real-world settings, the performance of Uni-Skill achieves an improvement of 20.0% on long-horizon tasks and 34.0% in unseen skills.
evidence.support_explanation: From Table III, Pick Place + Stack Blocks give Uni 0.70 vs CaP 0.50 (+20.0, reproduced). The other six tasks give Uni 0.733 vs MOKA 0.400 (+33.3), so 34.0 is not reproduced under that grouping, and the paper states no other grouping.

evidence.quote: is synthesized or retrieved on demand, ensuring sufficiency for specific task requirements.
evidence.support_explanation: L_ext is per-instruction. The text never states that synthesized skills persist into later tasks, so the 'self-augmented library' is not a defined retention mechanism.

evidence.quote: it further improves the success rates on Close Drawer and Seat Down by 12%.
evidence.support_explanation: The only execution-feedback loop is in-episode re-planning with negative examples. It has no denominator and is not retained across tasks.

evidence.quote: we trained it with 106K runtime code samples derived from videos demonstrations.
evidence.support_explanation: The planner VLM is weight-trained (base model unnamed). This confounds the comparison with prompted CaP/MOKA. The retained object being evaluated is still the non-weight repository (A3 bullet 2).

gap.author_gap: 技能中心方法被固定技能集所限；即便有文字描述，新技能仍依赖手工演示/路点标注；大规模机器人视频缺少技能标注而难以直接利用。
gap.checked_gap: 被改变的对象是'可用技能集及其示例来源'。库外任务上 CaP 0.01、MOKA 0.10 的基线表现为该瓶颈提供了经验支撑；但'自演化'实际是外部视频离线结构化+按需检索，不是由自身执行反馈驱动的库修改。
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: CaP/技能 API 代码生成(固定库)、MOKA(视觉提示关键点)、人类反馈补技能[8]、检索式行为克隆[29-31]；材料内仅有作者概括，未固定原文；未与 Voyager 式可执行技能库或其它'缺技能→合成/检索'方法对照。
gap.residue: 基线在库外任务上几近失败(0.01/0.10)；Uni-Skill 0.41 仍不足一半，失败集中在落地与方向错误。
gap.stakes: 机器人对新指令的零样本泛化，减少人工演示。
gap.method_response: 充分性判别→请求新技能→用 VerbNet 层级仓库检索语义/轨迹参考→视觉提示生成轨迹；消融文字显示'技能更新'机制最关键。
gap.remaining_gap: 技能是否持久化并跨任务复用、基于自身执行结果的修正、层级检索与重叠、成本、与训练过的非检索基线的比较均未回答。

rs_pattern.reason: Both seats C03. Retrieved demonstration slices (semantic constraints + projected trajectories) are a reference substrate conditioning waypoint generation for never-seen skills without per-skill training. son55's supporting decompose_and_delegate/C25 is dropped. C25's load-bearing move is closing the loop with a sound solver's verifiable output during construction. Here the planner's code calls fixed APIs, and waypoints are VLM-selected with no verifier (son55 itself graded S2–S5 unmet or absent). The one closed loop is an in-episode retry (opus:O04).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: A sufficiency discriminator detects a capability gap, a generator writes the missing skill description, and the skill is implemented from retrieved external demonstrations (H07 steps 1–2; C03 reference substrate).
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: H07 steps 3–5 (execution repair, registration, reuse evaluation) are absent. The 'skill' is a VLM-generated trajectory, not a verified registered tool (F2 partial).

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: SkillFolder is a four-layer VerbNet hierarchy with local child-node expansion. Content (slices) is reached through a separate semantic index, which is H04's restructured substrate.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: There is no flat-retrieval comparison at matched information and no scaling-cost certification. The substrate is built offline from videos, not from the agent's own execution.

assessment.evidence_level_note: Both seats. The output gains on RLBench and on the real robot are reported, but no retained change is shown to improve later tasks. Repository growth is offline, and L_ext persistence is undefined (opus:O03).
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: With a trained planner VLM plus SkillFolder-conditioned trajectory generation, Uni-Skill's average success on 10 author-chosen out-of-API RLBench tasks (0.41 vs MOKA 0.10; 3×25 episodes) and on 8 real tasks (0.73 vs 0.39, 10 trials) exceeds prompted baselines. Trained VLM and retrieval are confounded, and runtime self-evolution is not shown.
unresolved: Retrieval vs trained-VLM share of the gain

G.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. The fixed-API and manual-demonstration bottleneck is concrete, and the closest lines (code-as-policies, human-feedback skill addition, retrieval-based BC) are named with stated differences.
